title: Communication complexity of the Index function
statement: For every positive integer $n$, the deterministic two-way communication complexity of the Index function on an $n$-bit string and an index in $[n]$ is at most $\lceil\log_2 n\rceil+1$.
replaced:
The (two-way) deterministic communication complexity of $\mathrm{IND}_n$ is at most
$\lceil \log_2 n \rceil + 1$:
\[
  D(\mathrm{IND}_n) \le \lceil \log_2 n \rceil + 1,
\]
where $\lceil \log_2 n \rceil$ is formalised as $\mathrm{Nat.clog}\,2\,n$.  This is the
protocol in which Bob sends his index $i$ and Alice replies with the single bit $x_i$.
